CHIEF COMPLAINT: Palpitations for 2 days.

HISTORY OF PRESENT ILLNESS: 45-year-old reports intermittent palpitations, no chest pain, no syncope, no prior cardiac history.

REVIEW OF SYSTEMS: Positive for palpitations. Negative for chest pain, syncope, dyspnea.

PAST MEDICAL HISTORY: No chronic conditions.

PHYSICAL EXAM: Irregularly irregular heart rhythm on auscultation, no murmurs, mild bilateral lower extremity edema noted.

ASSESSMENT: New-onset atrial fibrillation, suspected.

PLAN: EKG and referral to cardiology, hold caffeine, follow up after cardiology evaluation.
